_comment: Machine-readable engineering baseline. Read by scripts/check-baseline.mjs and scripts/check-suppressions.mjs. Rules: docs/ENGINEERING-STANDARDS.md §1.1, §1.2, §5. Never raise a ceiling without a declaredGaps entry in the same commit.

declaredGaps.what: ESLint does not lint scripts/** at all — the lint script only covers src/**, test/** and server.js.
declaredGaps.why: Pre-existing. Measured at 83 no-undef errors and 8 warnings across 6 files. The scripts are Playwright drivers that reference browser globals (window, document) inside page.evaluate() callbacks, which need per-file-type config blocks (CJS vs ESM vs browser-context) rather than one blanket glob. Fixing this properly is its own reviewed change.
declaredGaps.bound: Must be closed before the TypeScript migration is declared complete; scripts/ must be lint-clean under a correct multi-scope eslint config.
declaredGaps.trackedBy: scripts/verify.mjs — printed as an open gap on every `npm run verify`
